content.short: reNFT is a multi-chain NFT rental protocol enabling collateral-free in-house renting, lending, and scholarship automation.
content.description: reNFT is a cross-chain NFT rental protocol and platform that enables collateral-free in-house renting, lending, and reward sharing (scholarship automation) for Web3 projects. By integrating reNFT, developers can rapidly add rental functionality to their applications, streamline workflows, and expand use cases across supported networks. The protocol supports multi-chain deployment and provides the tools to manage loans, automate scholarships, and onboard teams into a seamless rental experience within their ecosystems.
